facts.label: Name
facts.value: 扇面湖石道 (宫门前御道) Shanmian Hu shidao

facts.label: In English
facts.value: Causeway road between the Fan Lakes to the 大宫门

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a road outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: in use; raised causeway with rows of trees (S240 p.230, 1860)

facts.label: Where
facts.value: C: from the east-west road at 116.2960, 39.9959 north-west to the front of 大宫门 (repo YM41, 116.29061, 40.00097); no map read; the S01 plan may draw the 扇面湖 (repo YM41-13, unplaced)

facts.label: Joins
facts.value: start at OW042, end at YMC-001

facts.label: Note
facts.value: [j99:25a] (1763) 湖中置隄自北而南治石道東岸亦有石道 (a second stone road on the east bank: not drawn). Malone pp.68-69: branch 'ran northwestward between two lotus ponds toward the Great Palace Gate'. Swinhoe p.293: 'a sweep to the left ... between two large pieces of water'. 徐浩修 1790: two ponds 縱闊皆數百步, 南爲鋪石皇道.
